statement: Retrieval-based QA systems do not automatically adapt to updated facts: state-of-the-art open-retrieval systems given an updated evidence corpus are about 15 percentage points less accurate on questions asked in the present.

evidence.quote: We further quantify how existing models, which are trained on data collected in the past, fail to generalize to answering questions asked in the present, even when provided with an updated evidence corpus (a roughly 15 point drop in accuracy).
